title.narrative: Technical Cooperation Facility

description.narrative: The Technical Cooperation Facility (TCF) is designed to support the European Union (EU)-Jamaica cooperation with an emphasis on the preparation, implementation and management of the 11th EDF Multiannual Indicative Programme (2014-2020). The 11th EDF focuses on Justice, Climate change sectors as well as Public Finance Management, which have been selected on the basis of Jamaica's Vision 2030 and the European Union's Agenda for Change.
